meta.method: Scores were read automatically from the text of the official WHO JEE report PDFs listed in the WHO SPH document library (read in memory, not stored). A score is the number printed after each indicator title ("Score N"); the page is the PDF page number. Edition was assigned from the indicator set found in each report, not from the publication year. Reports with fewer than 28 indicator scores extracted were left out. Third-edition reports (2022 onward) were taken from WHO's IRIS repository; older reports from the WHO SPH document library.
